issues.issue: Automated flag on number '3' (reticular veins 1 to 3 mm) is a vessel-size descriptor whose '3 mm' bound is not in the population citation but is supported by the indication citation; benign false positive.
Automated flag on '12 weeks' is a false positive: the timepoint is supported by the endpoint citation ('taken at 12 weeks post-treatment'), not an efficacy magnitude.
Text adds 'small molecule' and 'detergent surfactant' which are not in the citation quote (quote supports only 'sclerosing agent'); minor over-claim beyond citation.
Field labeled 'vote' but no committee was convened and no vote exists; the text instead explains the non-referral (cosmetic mislabel, content is accurate).
